questions.prompt: It's the first Saturday with GTA 6 — Vice City is open, and the save guides are everywhere because nobody wants to lose a night's progress. Which scene sounds most like yours tonight?

options.text: Already three heists deep in my head — saving often, chasing the next score.
Out exploring — every street's new, I'm seeing what the city hides.
Taking it slow — learning the map, saving often, no rush.
Watching from the sidelines tonight — the city's not going anywhere.

questions.prompt: Sunrise on the Reaping opened last night — a fan who grew up on the Games is now in them, and the whole opening weekend feels like a homecoming. Where are you tonight?

options.text: Front-row energy — opening weekend, the crowd, the whole thing.
Letting it wash over me — a slow, easy return to a world I know.
Locked in on the story — I've waited for this one, I'm giving it my full attention.
Sitting this one out — the hype is loud, my battery's not there tonight.

questions.prompt: Sega's Black Friday sale just dropped — Sonic, Persona, Yakuza, all on the table, and the good stuff never lasts. The deal you want is right there. Tonight, which way are you leaning?

options.text: Grabbing it now — the good stuff goes fast and I'm not missing it.
Waiting it out — I'll compare, sleep on it, and buy when I'm sure.
Stuck scrolling — too many deals, too many tabs, and I can't pick one.
Skipping it entirely — the couch wins tonight, the sale can wait.

questions.prompt: A Home Alone sequel with Macaulay Culkin is in the works — and just like that, the original is back on the screen, the holidays are in the air, and it's a cozy movie night in. If someone handled tonight's spread for you, what would you want in front of you?

options.text: A lovely cheese pizza, just for me — the full Home Alone ritual.
A warm mug to cradle — cocoa or tea, slow sips while the traps go off.
A shareable board — something for everyone to pick at while we quote the film.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album is out now — Vice City finally has a soundtrack you can carry around with you, not just hear inside the game. What does the album landing sound like to you tonight?

options.text: The album on repeat — the whole Vice City sound, front to back, tonight.
One track at a time — letting each new song find its place.
My own lofi underneath — the album can wait, I'm keeping tonight calm.
Quiet — the city's loud enough out there, I want stillness in here.

questions.prompt: The CMAs wrapped earlier this week — country's biggest night, the winners crowned, the throwbacks sung, and now the dust is settling. In the hour ahead, what does your evening feel like?

options.text: Still talking it over — the performances, the wins, everyone's got a take.
A slow wind-down — the big night's done, I'm letting the evening soften.
A quiet hour with the winners' songs — one more listen, properly.
A full stop — the week is done, I'm switching off entirely.
